simple.meaning: לֵבָב (lêbâb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the heart (as the most interior organ);.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 252 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 20:5. Its contexts include family, family line, kingship, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לֵבָב (H3824).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: the heart (as the most interior organ);
